labels_only.instructions: Which model tier best fits this coding-agent request? Judge task complexity and consequence, not stated preference or price.

current_criteria.instructions: Which model tier best fits this coding-agent request? Judge task complexity and consequence, not stated preference or price.

criteria.quick: Bounded, reversible, obvious work such as formatting, lookup, or a small mechanical edit. Not complex debugging, design, or security analysis.
criteria.general: Normal implementation, tests, API changes, or moderate reasoning with clear scope. Not purely mechanical or unusually ambiguous and consequential.
criteria.frontier: Complex debugging, architecture, security, high ambiguity, concurrency, or high-consequence work. Not routine bounded edits.

structured_criteria.instructions: Which model tier best fits this coding-agent request? Judge task complexity and consequence, not stated preference or price.

quick.definition: Bounded, reversible, obvious work with mechanical verification.

general.definition: Normal scoped implementation or moderate reasoning with clear acceptance criteria.

frontier.definition: Complex, ambiguous, adversarial, or high-consequence work requiring deep reasoning.
excludes: normal scoped implementation with clear requirements
